blocks.text: Experiments ek ya zyada variables badal kar doosre par un ka asar dekhte hain, qaboo shuda halaat mein, jo science aur engineering ke liye munasib hai. Ustad ek group ko chhape notes deta aur doosre ko sirf lectures par chhorta hai; ek mahine baad dono ek hi test dete hain aur nataij ka muwazna hota hai ke notes ne madad ki ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Data science mein experimental design kya hai (MCQ 2)? Notes wale experiment mein control group kaunsa hai?
blocks.explanation: (b) data ko munazzam tareeqe se jama aur jaanchna. Control group woh class hai jo sirf lectures par hai; insaf ke liye dono groups milte julte, behtar ho ke tasadufi chune gaye, hon.

items: Experiment: ek variable badal kar control group se muwazna (chhape notes banam sirf lectures).
